alternatives_rejected.why: It calls productcatalogservice (E4). Its own self-time rose only 2.67x and inbound only 1.87x (E3), against 30.6x at productcatalogservice (E2). Its large latency-90 jump in E1 is consistent with inheriting delay from productcatalogservice.
frontend calls productcatalogservice and recommendationservice (E4). Its latency-50 deviation (E1) is smaller than productcatalogservice's and fits a downstream symptom.
Its own span self-time is unchanged (0.54x) while inbound latency is up 30.6x with zero errors (E2). That points to network-path delay rather than compute saturation.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice pods for injected network latency (e.g. a tc/netem qdisc or network chaos rule) and remove it. If none is found, check node/network health and reschedule the productcatalogservice pods onto healthy nodes. Then verify that inbound p50 returns to about 2-3ms.
